ig_caption:
Small talk leaves you empty because your hearing goes deeper than the room.
It is not coldness. Your ear is tuned below the surface, so thin sound cannot reach you.
Today, ask one person one real question and then just listen.
Comment DIVE if you would rather have one deep talk than ten polite ones, and send this to someone who needs it tonight.
